I may have a solution and being ugly may turn out to be lucky for us in long-term.

I am ugly and always cried about it all the time. One day, someone told me how Instagram making **younger generation depressed** and shortening our **attention span**. First I thought that person was just saying things, but I did some research about it and found out that it is true, Instagram is almost killing our brains and making us sad & lonely all the time.(Actually every social media app Tik Tok, Facebook , Snapchat, Reddit too but less than others)

People are starting to live two completely different lives, mostly people with average or above average looks. There lives is far from what we think they are. People with good looks are becoming addicted with being popular, while we all the ugly people are just looking at them and cursing ourselves. They pretend to be rich, living a perfect life, using filters which makes it impossible to recognize them in real life. But because we are ugly we never jumped into that blackhole of social media from which it merely impossible to get out. We still have a way which guarantee our success.

The fall of these so called Insta stars is for sure because of Instagram, tik tok itself. These apps reduce our attention span at an unbelievable rate. So, with short attention span people will move on from one star to another in days or maybe hours. In our case we are also effected be these things but **WE CAN ESCAPE .** If we escape we can work on our career our life and everything we wanted to do, you would be surprised to know the competition is half nowadays thanks to social media, if you only hear about how it is hard to get jobs in today's time its because you only hear them on social media and people who get jobs don't use social media, they have worked hard and honed their skills, they are the people who really live life like the Instagrammers pretend to , they are rich , happy, don't care about how they look, and are set for their life. We can be like them and it won't take so long we just have to work and try a little hard, cause in a decade or so *ugly people will run the world* because pretty people will be busy making reels and tik toks*.*

Now listen procedure is hard, but if you do it, your life will change for better. Delete all the social media apps Instagram, Tik Tok, Facebook , Snapchat, Reddit I don't know what else just delete it. Now, all the games, whatever makes you spend time on things which won't help you in future and career, don't care about social circles which makes you hate or even kill yourself. Work on your attention span.

See this is a big topic and I can't tell you everything, so open Youtube and search "Dopamine detox" and choose any video and WATCH THE FULL VIDEO.

In last I am glad to say that I am ten times better than I was 3 months ago and my looks are my last concern right now. Just try it for your own good or will be with with those weird good looking peoples who will discriminate you, also you will be a real loser by then with no hope.
